title: 1BD Loft for 4 Near Centennial Park
description:
✔️ Walk to Centennial Park, The Parthenon, and Vanderbilt
✔️ Modern 1BR, 1BA — sleeps up to 4
✔️ Full kitchen with stainless and stone counters
✔️ Smart TVs in living room and bedroom
✔️ In‑home washer/dryer and Wi‑Fi
✔️ Elevator building with under‑garage parking (first‑come)

The space
• West End Urban Suite pairs clean design with easy city access
• Sip coffee at the counter, then stroll Centennial Park and Vanderbilt
• Stream shows on smart TVs and unwind on the leather sofa
• Cook simple meals in the stainless kitchen with stone counters
• A relaxed base for couples, small families, or work‑and‑play trips

🌅 Indoor & Outdoor Living
• Chic living room with plush leather sofa and smart TV
• Large windows with city/urban views and great natural light
• Central air and heat for year‑round comfort
• 2nd‑floor unit in an elevator building

🛏️ Bedrooms & Sleeping Arrangements (Sleeps 4)
• This home includes 1 bedroom and 1 bathroom.
• Bedroom 1 — King bed; smart TV; sleeps 2
• Living Room — Queen sleeper sofa; smart TV; sleeps 2
• Bathroom — Hall access; tub/shower combo; single vanity

🍳 Kitchen & Dining
• Full kitchen with stainless appliances and stone countertops
• Counter seating for casual meals
• Cookware, bakeware, utensils, are provided
• Salt, pepper, and cooking oil are not provided

🏖️ What's Included
• In‑unit/home washer and dryer for longer stays
• We provide bedding, towels and a small starter set of essentials
• Wi‑Fi and smart TVs (use your streaming accounts)
• Long‑term stays welcome

📍 Location Highlights
• Centennial Park & The Parthenon — easy walk
• Vanderbilt University — walkable West End campus
• Broadway/Downtown — quick rideshare for live music and honky‑tonks
• Midtown/Division Street — bars, dining, coffee nearby
• Hillsboro Village & Music Row — boutiques and studios within minutes

🚗 Parking, Safety & Notes
• Parking: Under‑building garage parking for 1 vehicle (first‑come); additional street parking first‑come; not guaranteed
• Elevator: Operated by building management; if unavailable, stairs are required
• Pets: This home is not pet friendly. If there is found evidence of an animal's presence during your stay or post check‑out, guests will be charged an additional cleaning fee
• Security: One exterior camera at the front door monitors entry only
• Laundry: Private washer and dryer in unit
• Check‑in time is 4:00 PM and checkout time is 10:00 AM
